dots_position.description: Draw the column dots left or right of the column text (Dots style)
dots_position.label: Column dots

double_tap_ms.description: How soon after the first tap the second must start to count as a double-tap
double_tap_ms.label: Double-tap window (ms)

hold_delay_ms.description: How long Super must be held before it counts as a hold; shorter presses are taps
hold_delay_ms.label: Hold delay (ms)

on_change.description: Show the overlay for the duration below when the workspace, column or window changes
on_change.label: On position change

on_double_tap.description: Show the overlay for the duration below when Super is tapped twice quickly
on_double_tap.label: On Super double-tap

on_hold.description: Show the overlay while the Super key is held
on_hold.label: While Super is held

style.description: Dots for the workspace and column positions, or a mini-map of every workspace's columns and windows
style.label: Style

timeout_ms.description: How long the overlay stays on screen after a position change or double-tap
timeout_ms.label: Duration (ms)
